features.title: For agile workplaces, Swift tables with castors deliver lightweight mobility, letting teams reconfigure spaces effortlessly.
For dynamic offices, Swift tables offer castor mobility, foldable frames, and stackable design for fast transitions and tidy storage.
Swift nested tables keep spaces dynamic with mobile, reconfigurable design and built-in power access, making them perfect for modern work environments.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Swift 1650 X 600 Nested Table
